name: Class 385
description: The British Rail Class 385 eXpress is a type of electric multiple unit built by Hitachi Rail. Initially operated by Abellio ScotRail, and now its state-owned successor, a total of 70 units have been built, divided into 46 three-car and 24 four-car sets. Based on the design of the Hitachi A-train, they are part of the Hitachi AT200 product family and are branded as eXpress by Scotrail.
